rules.summary: While school is in session, minors under 16 may work at most 3 hours a day and 18 a week, 6 consecutive days, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. in summer vacation).

citation.title: 26 M.R.S. § 774 — Hours of employment of minors
citation.excerpt: B. More than 18 hours in any week when school is in session; C. More than 8 hours in any day when school is not in session; D. More than 3 hours in any day when school is in session

rules.summary: When school is not in session, minors under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day, 40 a week and 6 consecutive days, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. in summer vacation).

citation.title: 26 M.R.S. § 774 — Hours of employment of minors
citation.excerpt: A. More than 40 hours in any week when school is not in session ... F. Between the hours of 7 p.m. and 7 a.m. except during summer vacation

rules.summary: Enrolled 16- and 17-year-olds may work at most 6 hours on a school day (8 on the last school day of the week and on non-school days), 24 hours a week, 7 a.m.-10:15 p.m. before a school day (midnight otherwise).

citation.title: 26 M.R.S. § 774 — Hours of employment of minors
citation.excerpt: B. More than 24 hours in any week when the minor's school is in session ... D. More than 6 hours in any day when the minor's school is in session

rules.summary: When school is not in session, enrolled 16- and 17-year-olds may work at most 10 hours a day, 50 a week and 6 consecutive days, 5 a.m.-midnight.

citation.title: 26 M.R.S. § 774 — Hours of employment of minors
citation.excerpt: A. More than 50 hours in any week when the minor's school is not in session ... C. More than 10 hours in any day when the minor's school is not in session
